# openobserve_user_roles (Data Source)

Lists the built-in user roles this OpenObserve deployment accepts. The set differs between the open-source and Enterprise editions, so read it here rather than hard-coding role names.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The set of built-in roles differs between the open-source and Enterprise
# editions, so read it rather than hard-coding role names.
data "openobserve_user_roles" "available" {}

output "available_roles" {
  value = data.openobserve_user_roles.available.roles
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `org_id` (String) Organization identifier. Defaults to the provider's `org_id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source ID.
- `role_options` (Attributes List) The same roles with their display labels. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--role_options))
- `roles` (List of String) Built-in role names, for example `admin`, `editor`, `viewer`. These are the values accepted by `openobserve_user.role`.

<a id="nestedatt--role_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `role_options`

Read-Only:

- `label` (String) Human-readable role name.
- `value` (String) Value to pass to `openobserve_user.role`.
